answer.short: Bottom middle: $3$; middle right: $-2$; top: $-7$. Use $-8+3=-5$, then add adjacent cells.
answer.worked:
The bottom-middle number is $3$: moving three units right from $-8$ reaches $-5$.

$$\begin{align*}
-8+3&=-5\\
3+(-5)&=3-5\\
&=-2\\
-5+(-2)&=-5-2\\
&=-7
\end{align*}$$
